meta.description: Tests knowledge of the primary function of the Transport layer.

question.text: What is the primary function of the Transport layer (Layer 4) in the OSI model?
options: Providing physical transmission of bits across a network medium
Providing end-to-end communication and reliable data delivery
Determining the best path for packets between networks
Translating data into a format that applications can understand
question.correctAnswer: Providing end-to-end communication and reliable data delivery
